correctness.rationale: For a fixed nilpotent partial injection alpha of rank r, both zero compositions force beta domain/image into complements of alpha image/domain, each of size n-r; cycles of beta must be supported on the isolated vertices of alpha. Inclusion-exclusion over directed cycles cancels contributions supported on >=2 selected vertices, giving binom(n-r,s)^2*s! - c*binom(n-r-1,s-1)^2*(s-1)!. Lah-number counting and singleton marking sum these terms, then a fully checked factorial identity yields the symmetric formula. Boundary n=1 and r=n-1 are handled separately. Direct exhaustive pair enumeration for n<=6 matches all rank cells.

value.rationale: The two-rank distribution for nilpotent mutual annihilation is an intrinsic multiplication-incidence invariant of the symmetric inverse monoid, fully determined at all sizes rather than a hand-picked parameter slice. The two-term conditional cycle sieve, invariant under all nontrivial chain-length changes at fixed rank and singleton count, and sharp feasible-rank triangle are structural results with clear use in nilpotent subsemigroup incidence enumeration.
